plain.li: [feastwelcome,us] Come in and rest your legs, it's a long day yet.
[feastwelcome,us,kind] You must be tired, come and sit before anything else.
[feastwelcome,us,abrasive] You're here, good, now try not to get underfoot.
[feastwelcome,us,!lowtech] Welcome, wipe your boots, and don't mind the noise.
[feastwelcome,us,theirHightech] Welcome, we'll find you somewhere to sit while you wait.
[feastarrive,them] We'd have come sooner, but the road had other ideas.
[feastarrive,them,theirLowtech] Our people send their greetings, and our best send their boasts.
[feastarrive,them,theirHightech] Good to be here, the road was better than the maps said.
[feastarrive,them,kind] Thank you for asking us, it means more than you'd think.
[feastarrive,them,abrasive] Well, we're here, so where's this feast of yours?
[weddingarrive,them] We've come to see one of ours married, and we're glad of the road for once.
[weddingarrive,them] So this is where they'll live, it looks a good place to grow old in.
[weddingarrive,them,theirLowtech] We come as kin to a wedding, with our people's blessing on it.
[weddingarrive,them,theirHightech] We're here for the wedding, is there anything we should know?
[weddingarrive,them,kind] Look after the one we're giving you, they're dear to us.
[weddingarrive,them,abrasive] I hope your people are worth the walk, and the one we're losing to you.
[weddingarrive,them,old] I've walked to a good many weddings, and this road was the longest.
[feastrungo] Ready, steady, and off with you.
[feastrungo] Out to the marker and home again, go.
[feastrunstumble] That stone wasn't there a moment ago.
[feastrunstumble,abrasive] Who left that lying there?
[feastrunwin,kind] Well run, all of you, it was closer than it looked.
[feastrunwin,teen] I told them I was the fastest.
[feastrunlose] My legs gave up halfway back.
[feastrunlose,old] I was winning races before you were born.
[feasthuntwin] Clean kills, all of them, and nothing wasted.
[feasthuntwin,them,theirHightech] Good hunting ground, you're lucky to have it so close.
[feasthuntwin,us,tribal] The spirits gave us a good hunt for our guests.
[feasttablewin] Good game, I nearly lost my nerve in the middle.
[feasttablewin,them,theirLowtech] We play this at home on long nights, so it wasn't quite fair.
[feasttablelose,abrasive] Luck, nothing else, and you know it.
[feasttablelose,kind] You earned that, and I'll want a rematch.
[feastshootgood] Steady hands today, I'll take it.
[feastshootfair] Not my best, not my worst.
[feastshootpoor] My eyes aren't what they were.
[feastwinner] Here's to our hosts, and to everyone who lost with good grace.
[feastwinner,them,theirLowtech] Drink, all of you, to the colony and its table.
[feastwinner,us,!lowtech] To our guests, may they go home happy and come back hungry.
[feastwinner,kind] To everyone who took part, win or lose.
[feastwinner,teen] I'm going to remember today for the rest of my life.
[feastprize,us] You've earned this, take it with our thanks.
[feastprize,us,theirHightech] Here's the prize, and it's yours to keep.
[feastprizethanks,them,theirLowtech] My people will hang this where everyone can see it.
[feastprizethanks,us] I'll put it somewhere I can see it every day.
[feastsour,them] Laugh at me once more and we'll settle it outside.
[feastsour,them,theirHightech] I've had about enough of your mouth for one night.
[invitation,warm,feast:invited,letter] Your letter was read out twice, the second time because the children asked. We will come to {FEAST}.
[invitation,warm,feast:invited,call] Of course we'll come, {WRITER}. We were hoping you'd call.
[invitation,cordial,feast:invited] A feast is a feast, {WRITER}, and we don't turn one down. Expect us at {FEAST}.
[invitation,cordial,feast:invited,theirLowtech] We will come to {FEAST} as guests should, hungry and in good time.
[invitation,cordial,feast:invited,theirHightech] We'll be there for {FEAST}. If there's a dress code, tell us now and not at the gate.
[invitation,cool,feast:invited,letter] Our thanks for the invitation to {FEAST}. The road is long this season, and we will stay at home.
[invitation,cool,feast:invited,call] Kind of you to call, {WRITER}. We'll have to miss {FEAST} this time.
[invitation,curt,feast:invited,theirHightech] No. We have other commitments.
[invitation,refusal,feast:invited,theirLowtech] Our people do not sit at the table of strangers.
[invitation,refusal,feast:invited,call] I won't be coming to {FEAST}, {WRITER}, and I'd rather not say why.
[greetings,warm,feast:soon] Our guests for {FEAST} have packed their best clothes already, and keep unpacking them to check.
[greetings,cordial,feast:soon,theirLowtech] Those who will go to {FEAST} have been chosen, and the rest of us are already jealous.
[condolences,warm,feast:soon] We grieve with you, {WRITER}. If {FEAST} goes ahead, our people will come gladly, and if it doesn't, we understand.
[warning,cordial,feast:soon] Thank you for the warning. Our guests for {FEAST} will keep their eyes open on the road.
[help,cordial,feast:soon] We can help, and we will see you at {FEAST} besides.
[greetings,warm,town:lately:dip:feast,theirLowtech] Those who went to {FEAST} came home with full bellies and more stories than we have evenings for.
[greetings,cordial,feast:good] Our people speak well of {FEAST}, {WRITER}, and they are not easy to please.
[greetings,cool,feast:poor] We heard how {FEAST} went. We expected better of your colony.
[greetings,cool,feast:poor,theirHightech] Those who came back from {FEAST} had little good to report.
[help,warm,them:feastguest,feast:welcomed,theirLowtech] You fed us well at {FEAST}. Now let us return it.
[news,cordial,them:feastguest] Here is our news, and our thanks again for {FEAST}. I still think of your table.
[greetings,cordial,feast:theywon,theirLowtech] {CHAMPION} has told the story of {FEAST} at every meal since, and we are all learning it by heart.
[greetings,cool,feast:theywon] {CHAMPION} won at {FEAST}, as you know. Some here say your people let it happen.
[greetings,warm,feast:wewon] We have forgiven {CHAMPION} for {FEAST}, {WRITER}. Our best has not, and trains every morning.
[invitation,cordial,town:lately:dip:feast,theirLowtech] After {FEAST} we owe your colony a seat at our own table. We will come, and you must come to us after.
[condolences,warm,town:lately:dip:feast] We sat at your table so lately, and now this. We grieve with you.
[greetings,cool,them:feastguest,feast:slighted,theirHightech] I was your guest at {FEAST} and went home hungry. I mention it so you know it was noticed.
